description: fnpf_3d_coral_array_x36 on 2 ranks: the patches cut at the rank boxes, a window over both ranks. The pieces of a patch that do not reach into the zone are not in the window, so the windows differ from those of one rank; the outputs within 1e-4 of their largest value, the log of the refinement not compared.
covers: X 36 on 2 ranks: the windows from the patches of all ranks (Allgatherv of their boxes, the global patch table), the restriction of a skipped child on another rank (reefamr::block_up sends NaN)
